exam_name: Ontario DECA EIP Regional Online Exam
description: Ontario DECA Entrepreneurship Innovation Plan (EIP) Regional Qualifying Online Multiple Choice Exam. Rigorous assessment covering Financial Analysis, Marketing Strategy, Unit Economics, and Venture Operations.

stages.desc_en: 20-question stratified diagnostic across all domains to establish baseline competency.
stages.desc_zh: 跨模块20题抽样摸底，测出初始知识短板与基线正确率。

stages.desc_en: Deep-dive into specific weak topics with bilingual explanations and distractor reasoning.
stages.desc_zh: 逐个模块靶向突破，结合双语选项错因深度掌握核心概念。

stages.desc_en: Bayesian-smoothed mistake bank targeting high-frequency pitfalls until 100% resolved.
stages.desc_zh: 错题本贝叶斯加权攻坚，消灭高频混淆项直到完全掌握。

stages.desc_en: Official 70-minute, 100-question timed simulation under real benchmark pressure (75% pass line).
stages.desc_zh: 官方70分钟/100题闭卷全真模拟，以75%及格线检验应考能力。

stages.desc_en: 5-10 personalized adaptive test sets (60% weak, 25% new, 15% review) for final exam readiness.
stages.desc_zh: 5-10套自适应个性化模考，全面巩固薄弱点，冲刺达标认证。
